verdict.rationale: Antigravity 2.0 documents Scheduled Tasks: you define a cron schedule and agents start and run autonomously in the background. It also supports scheduled messages to agents while you are away, and a headless CLI mode for CI pipelines that can serve as a trigger path. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on scheduled-task configuration and on event-based triggers beyond CI, clarity on how the approval-halting planning mode interacts with unattended fixes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of always-on maintenance runs.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can set up always-on agents that run on schedules or triggers to maintain and fix my software autonomously

citations.quote: Automate routine checks with Scheduled Tasks, simply define a cron schedule and the agents start and run autonomously in the background.
users can schedule messages to be sent to their agents while they’re away
Run Antigravity CLI non-interactively to script agent tasks, integrate with CI pipelines, and capture machine-readable output.
